subject: MAP Acceleration: Renewal + New Teams — Check-in and Owners
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@credencehealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@credencehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Acceleration: Renewal + New Teams — Check-in and Owners

Hi Aisha / Marco —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a concise MAP and a proposed 4-week acceleration timeline so Credence can bring the two new product teams onboard before the Q3 rollout. Primary goals: preserve current unit economics while onboarding two new teams, and scope the add-on for advanced embeddings for the clinical search pilot.

Attached: Credence_MAP_v2.xlsx (master MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria). Highlights below:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize legal/SOW placeholders and confirm procurement contact (Procurement: procurement@credencehealth.com).
- Week 1: pilot team A onboarding (usage baseline + 1 week eval).
- Week 2: enable Team B + embedding add-on trial.
- Week 3–4: scale seeds, finalize add-on order, and sign commitment for reserved capacity (if required).

Asks:
1) Please confirm procurement contact + preferred DocuSign window.
2) Marcus (cc) — can you validate quota targets and whether we should propose a 10% discount for the first month of new-team usage?
3) Aisha/Marco — are there specific acceptance criteria your teams want added to the MAP (data retention, audit log granularity, SLA percentiles)?

I suggest a 30-minute weekly MAP checkpoint on Thursdays at 10am PT to keep momentum — happy to shift if that doesn't work for your team.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Credence_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@credencehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@credencehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Acceleration: Renewal + New Teams — Check-in and Owners

Thanks Camila — this looks promising. A few items from our side:

- Procurement: procurement@credencehealth.com is correct; our purchasing lead (Kelly Tan) will own contracts. Expect them to ask for our SOC 2 report and data processing addendum.
- Acceptance criteria: for the embedding pilot we need recall >= 0.85 on the initial eval set and response P95 latency < 350ms. Please add those two metrics to the MAP.
- Discount asks: we'll need a short trial discount for the first 30 days of Team B onboarding; 10% sounds reasonable — can you confirm this will be honored if we expand?

We can do the weekly checkpoint Thursdays at 10am PT; Marco and I can join next week.

FWIW, procurement asked if you can share a sample SOW and the SOC 2 summary now so they can pre-clear.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Acceleration: Renewal + New Teams — Check-in and Owners

Camila —

Quick internal note after I pulled the usage report (attached). Key numbers: current Credence monthly token consumption ~ 2.1B tokens, 65% of traffic from the clinical search team. Projected incremental usage for Team A + Team B = ~420M tokens/month by the end of week 4.

Recommendation: offer a bespoke add-on SKU for embeddings at a 12% unit discount for the first 30 days tied to expansion, rather than a blanket account discount. This preserves baseline revenue and keeps the add-on economics explicit. If procurement prefers a consolidated line-item discount, we can propose 10% recurring for 3 months (contingent on commit).

Action items for MAP sheet:
- Update week-2 row to include acceptance metrics (added recall/latency cells).
- Add pricing_addon_quote_v3.pdf to attachments with SKU breakdown and provisional PO lines.
- Priyom: please draft a short SOW template we can send to procurement (2 pages max).

Attachments: usage_report_may.csv, pricing_addon_quote_v3.pdf

Marcus Lin
Growth Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@credencehealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@credencehealth.com>, procurement@credencehealth.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Acceleration: Renewal + New Teams — Check-in and Owners

Aisha / Marco / Kelly (procurement) —

Thanks for confirming the acceptance criteria and procurement lead. Attached is the updated MAP (Credence_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the embedding recall >=0.85 and P95 latency <350ms added under "Acceptance" for the pilot. Marcus attached the usage and the provisional add-on quote — appreciate that context.

Priyom: can you please draft the 2-page SOW and a 1-page security appendix (SOC 2 summary + data handling notes)? Rishi — I flagged you on the pricing suggestion; can you confirm the 12% first 30-day add-on discount vs the 10% 3-month account-level option by EOD Monday? We want to give procurement a clear recommendation.

Next checkpoint: Thursday 10am PT (May 27) — I'll send calendar invite.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

Quoted attachments: Credence_MAP_v2.xlsx (updated), pricing_addon_quote_v3.pdf

Thanks everyone — this is clear and aligned. Procurement (Kelly) will review the SOW and SOC summary once Camila / Priyom share them. We accept the proposed timeline and the approach to the add-on SKU. We prefer the 12% first-30-days add-on discount (keeps accounting simple).

Next steps (agreed):
- Camila / Redwood: share 2-page SOW + security appendix (Priyom to draft).
- Procurement: review and flag any final legal redlines (Kelly).
- Redwood pricing: Rishi to confirm discount option by Monday EOD.
- Weekly checkpoints Thursdays 10am PT (first: May 27).

Attached: signed_map_agreement.pdf (placeholder - procurement requested an initial sign-off to begin internal approvals; this is not the final SOW).
